from __future__ import annotations


def check_name(name: str) -> bool:
    # Imported lazily: `pkg.models` imports `check_name` at module load, so a
    # module-level import here would close the cycle between the two modules.
    from pkg.models import DEFAULT_NAME

    if not name or name == DEFAULT_NAME.upper():
        raise ValueError(name)
    return True
